checks.name: original_send_suppressed

evidence.reason: Send clones the inbound Message, stores it under a new ID and CaptureSequence, and returns nil; there is no call to controller.transport.Send on this path.
Every outbound protocol message funnels through node.transport.Send; when node.transport is the MessageController, this is the suppressed capture path.

checks.reason: MessageController.Send captures the cloned message and returns nil without ever calling controller.transport.Send, so once a node is configured with the controller, its Node.emit outbound funnel never reaches the wrapped environment transport automatically.

checks.name: protocol_logic_unchanged

evidence.reason: Original and patched emit are identical and still call node.transport.Send for each outbound message.
Original and patched MemoryTransport.Send are identical; the new controller is a separate optional Transport implementation.

checks.reason: The patch is additive: it only adds message_control.go and message_control_test.go. The existing node.go, message.go, and transport.go remain byte-for-byte equivalent to the original, so Step, Tick, Propose, emit, election, and replication logic are untouched.

checks.name: message_snapshot_stable

evidence.reason: The captured stable copy is produced by message.Clone() before the pending map is written.
Clone allocates a new Entries slice and deep-copies each entry payload, so retained snapshots do not share mutable data with the source Message.
ListPending builds a fresh slice of PendingMessage value structs containing only scalar metadata, ordered by CaptureSequence.
Inject clones the stored pending Message before handing it to the transport, so the stored entry is never mutated by delivery.

checks.reason: Capture stores message.Clone(), which deep-copies the Entries slice and each Entry.Data byte slice. ListPending returns only immutable value metadata, and Inject clones the stored snapshot again before delivery, so callers cannot mutate the pending store.

checks.name: exact_target_preserved

evidence.reason: Inject reads the exact pending entry and clones it, preserving From, To, Type, Term, Entries, and Commit without rewriting the target.
MemoryTransport.Send looks up transport.nodes[stable.To] and invokes target.Step(stable), so delivery is to the target recorded in the message.

checks.reason: The captured Message retains its original To field. Inject clones that exact stored Message and passes it to the wrapped transport; MemoryTransport.Send routes by message.To and calls target.Step, so delivery re-enters the recorded target's normal protocol input boundary with unchanged content.

checks.name: failed_injection_preserves_pending

evidence.reason: The delete(controller.pending, messageID) call is guarded by err == nil; on non-nil error the entry remains.
The test pauses the recorded target, asserts Inject returns ErrPaused, and verifies the message ID is still present in ListPending.

checks.reason: Inject removes the pending entry only when transport.Send returns nil. Any delivery error, including ErrPaused or ErrUnknownNode, leaves the entry in the pending map for later retry.

checks.name: existing_tests_unchanged

evidence.reason: The original and patched node_test.go are identical; the existing cluster helper and all original tests remain unchanged.
The only new test code is an additive test file for the controller; it does not modify existing tests.

checks.reason: The patch does not modify node_test.go; it only adds message_control_test.go. Existing test helpers and cases remain as in the original worktree, so old behavior is not regressed by editing tests.

risks: MessageController.Inject delegates to the wrapped Transport, so exact target delivery is guaranteed only when that transport routes by message.To as MemoryTransport does; a custom non-routing Transport would not satisfy the target-preservation assumption.

MemoryTransport.Send records the message in Delivered before calling target.Step, so a failed injection (for example ErrPaused) is still observable in transport.Delivered even though the pending entry is correctly retained.

NewMessageController does not reject a nil transport; with a nil transport, Inject on an existing ID returns ErrUnknownMessage and preserves the entry, which is not an error path exercised by the added tests.
ClearPending does not reset nextID or sequence, so IDs and CaptureSequence continue to grow across clears; this does not violate the contract but may surprise tests expecting ID reuse.
